I have been trying to unlock the any of the F5 variants for a week by now.

Since so far it was a complete fail with any of the F5 heroes it looks like the prerequisite is not met. 

Either I am doing something wrong after all, some condition is not in the description or it is a bug....

" First, the Prime Wardens (all variant members) must be defeated by Progeny anywhere other than Rook City or Megalopolis. Then, Dark Watch (all variant members) must by defeated by Progeny in Rook City. Then, the Freedom Five (non-variant members) must be defeated by Progeny in Rook City."

What does the "(all variant members)" mean? Any one variant member or do I have to cycle with all variant memebers of the heroes? So far I did it with the normal heroes, accelerating my defeat by skiping play and power phase.

 

Thank you

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
"Variant members" refers to the playing as the Prime Wardens team (Argent Adept, Captain Cosmic, Fanatic, Haka and Tempest) using their Prime Wardens' Character Cards (the ones with these powers respectively; Conduct, Absorption, Resolute, Guardian and Arc of Power).

 

EDIT: Also, welcome to the forum!

Any ideas?

If you haven't tried the Friendly Fire/Crowbars combo, give it a shot, you might be surprised.

Dark Watch Setback is widely considered the hardest variant to unlock, so don't feel bad if you're struggling. It pretty much comes down to restarting the game until you have a good card draw and/or the starting Underbosses you want.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Crowbars+Friendly Fire explanation.

  1. Mr Fixer hits The Operative with his power.
  2. Because has dealt damage to a non-hero target, Friendly Fire triggers and asks if Mr Fixer wants to deal damage to Setback.
  3. Mr Fixer deals damage to Setback.
  4. Mr Fixer has dealt damage, Dual Crowbars triggers and Mr Fixer hits The Operative with this "Dual" hit.
  5. Go to 2.

So everytime you deal Setback 3 damage, you can deal The Operative 5 damage!

Setback gets absolutely wrecked but gains a ton of tokens and The Operative is probably dead.

Huzzahs!
